extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues affecting the question: (1) three rows with negative flipper_length_mm values (below the minimum allowed 170) were excluded as invalid; (2) 'island' labels had case and space variants ('Dream ' and 'torgersen') which were normalized to 'Dream' and 'Torgersen' to match the allowed values; (3) the 'flipper_length_mm' column was stored as text in some rows, but no conversion was needed after fixing the negative values and normalizing labels. After these fixes, the average flipper length by species was calculated: Adelie: 190.18 mm, Chinstrap: 199.64 mm, Gentoo: 215.14 mm.
